svg.text: Double-entry ledger: accounts and example entries
Every money movement is one journal entry whose debits equal credits. Wallet balances are the sum of postings, never an edited number. Amounts and fees are examples.
ASSET · money held by Lipila and networks
A wallet balance is the sum of its postings. The cached balance on the wallet row
is updated in the same transaction and checked against the ledger each night.
Postings are never updated or deleted. A mistake is fixed by a reversing entry that
points to the original. Every entry has a unique reference.
Wallets + card pool + fee income must equal provider clearing + settlement bank.
Any gap raises a critical alert.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
